title: The Murder of Sherlock Holmes
synopsis: Jessica Fletcher, a retired English teacher from Cabot Cove, Maine, attends a costume party in New York City where a real murder occurs.

title: Deadly Lady
synopsis: Jessica visits San Francisco to see her niece and becomes involved in a murder investigation at a prestigious law firm.

title: Birds of a Feather
synopsis: Jessica investigates a murder at a country club where she is vacationing.

title: Hooray for Homicide
synopsis: Jessica visits Hollywood where one of her books is being adapted into a movie, but the producer is murdered.

title: It's a Dog's Life
synopsis: Jessica helps investigate when a valuable show dog's owner is murdered.

title: Lovers and Other Killers
synopsis: During a visit to New York, Jessica becomes involved in investigating the death of a businessman.

title: Hit, Run and Homicide
synopsis: Jessica investigates when a local politician is killed in what appears to be a hit-and-run accident.

title: We're Off to Kill the Wizard
synopsis: Jessica visits a technology company where a computer genius is murdered.

title: Death Takes a Curtain Call
synopsis: Jessica investigates when a member of a touring Russian ballet company is murdered.

title: Death Casts a Spell
synopsis: A famous hypnotist is found dead at a charity event Jessica is attending.

title: Widow, Weep for Me
synopsis: Jessica visits Hawaii to help investigate when a wealthy widow's husband is found dead.

title: Joshua Peabody Died Here... Possibly
synopsis: Jessica investigates when a local historian is murdered while researching a centuries-old mystery.

title: Murder in the Afternoon
synopsis: Jessica visits the set of a soap opera where one of the actors is murdered.

title: School for Murder
synopsis: Jessica returns to her alma mater for a reunion and finds murder on the curriculum.

title: Sing a Song of Murder
synopsis: Jessica attends a country music festival where a singer is found murdered.

title: Death Stalks the Big Top (Part 1)
synopsis: Jessica joins a traveling circus and becomes involved in murder when a performer is killed.

title: Death Stalks the Big Top (Part 2)
synopsis: The conclusion of the circus mystery as Jessica unmasks the killer.

title: Unfinished Business
synopsis: Jessica helps solve a decades-old murder case in Cabot Cove.

title: One White Rose for Death
synopsis: Jessica travels to Vienna where she becomes caught up in international intrigue and murder.

title: Crossed Up
synopsis: Jessica investigates when a crossword puzzle constructor is murdered.

title: A Fashionable Way to Die
synopsis: Jessica attends a fashion show in New York where a model is murdered.

title: When Thieves Fall Out
synopsis: A group of thieves plan a heist but one of them ends up dead.

title: Witness for the Defense
synopsis: Jessica is called as a witness in a murder trial but begins to doubt the defendant's guilt.

title: Old Habits Die Hard
synopsis: Jessica investigates murder at a convent where she went to school.

title: The Way to Dusty Death
synopsis: Jessica visits a race track where a driver is found murdered.

title: J.B. As In Jailbird
synopsis: Jessica is arrested for murder and must prove her innocence from behind bars.

title: A Little Night Work
synopsis: Jessica investigates when a jewel thief is murdered during a heist.

title: Mr. Penroy's Vacation
synopsis: Jessica helps a mild-mannered accountant who stumbles into a murder mystery during his vacation.

title: Snow White, Blood Red
synopsis: Jessica investigates murder at a ski resort in the mountains.

title: Coal Miner's Slaughter
synopsis: Jessica visits West Virginia to research a book and finds murder in a coal mining town.
